findings: `learner.overview.text` presents the traditional 誰 analysis as the construction of simplified 谁 without clarifying that the connection between them is a character-level simplification relationship. Revise it to say that 誰 is the traditional counterpart and that its proposed 言-plus-隹 analysis belongs to 誰; preserve the caveat that the ancient sound connection remains uncertain. The component cards already clarify the host, but the overview itself can mislead.
